description: Land Acquisition - Thibirigaswewa Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for a public purpose (Upper Elahera Canal Project), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, possessors, and exact measurements. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
